review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: S3 stinger veil body (role: passive hazard, size 3): a tall lilac bell with ten darker radial canals and a pale rim, small dark eyes under a soft brow. The engine draws its stinging threads. Built on the ambush hunter's body code, so its nodes and material names are the ambush hunter's.

textures.name: T_AmbushHunter_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_AmbushHunter_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

frame.source: game/scenes/pool/part_placement.gd RX and RZ; the part GLBs sit on this outline at the swim plane

pivot: body centre on the swim plane (Godot y = 0); built at size 1, the creature view scales it by the species' body_size

pose_nodes.Eye_L: child of Body, origin at the eye's centre; material M_AmbushEye, whose emission the creature view drives
pose_nodes.Brow: child of Body, origin at the middle of the ridge

vertex_colors.encoding: sRGB-encoded in COLOR_0; the engine material sets vertex_color_is_srgb (assets/export/M_AmbushBody.tres)
vertex_colors.note: Dark olive-brown back with blue-leaning mottles and light olive flecks, dark rings round the eye sockets, a cream belly.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; body vertex colours kept within 0.04 per channel; full-detail shading (a body built at a finer tessellation) baked to the normal map

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_endless_threats.py on the step 3 body code (make_m1_threats.py, make_m1_production.py); no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
